project.name: Representative NC Civil Rights Matter
project.objective: Maintain claim-by-claim, defendant-by-defendant litigation research with verified authority and evidence mapping.
definition_of_done: Approved claim architecture, defendant/capacity map, and source model are recorded.
constraints: Primary authority must support consequential legal propositions

architecture.summary: Separate defendants, capacities, claims, threshold defenses, evidence, remedies, and procedural posture.
boundaries: Material changes to forum, defendant set, capacity theory, or controlling claim theory require a new architecture decision
dependencies: Source baseline -> Claim and defense matrices
Claim and defense matrices -> Drafting and review

sources: Primary federal and North Carolina authority
risks: Threshold defenses may dispose of otherwise plausible claims

routing.policy: Use low-cost tiers for bounded evidence organization and strong independent review for high-stakes claim analysis.

domain.forum_jurisdiction: Fictional Synthetic District Court; forum label only; source: synthetic case fixture.
domain.defendants_roles: Fictional Officer Alpha (patrol officer), Director Beta (licensing director) and Town of Gamma (employer); no finding of liability.
domain.capacities: Officer Alpha individual and official; Director Beta official; Town of Gamma entity only.
domain.alleged_rights: Fictional stand-in rights against unreasonable seizure and to a pre-revocation hearing; no real authority asserted.
domain.procedural_history: Fictional pre-filing research; no proceeding commenced and nothing preserved yet.
domain.evidence_sources: Synthetic complaint, roster, dispatch log and stop log placeholders; authentication not yet assessed.
domain.limitations_accrual: Fictional accrual dates 2026-01-10 and 2026-02-01; tolling not yet researched; no actual deadline.
domain.objectives_remedies: Ranked fictional objectives: damages for the detention, then reinstatement of the license.
domain.prior_proceedings: No fictional prior or parallel proceeding is declared in this fixture.
domain.reserved_actions: Filing, service, contacting any court, party or witness, and disclosure are reserved to the user.

workflow.policy: One bounded issue per task; link validation and independent review in a PR; accept only inside the approved foundation.
